entries.back_en: "blub blub... does not need to breathe. Still, she says she thanks you for your help."
"Yes—we're looking for my sister. Her name is Elina. We were told she had come here..."
"Princess Elina, yes? Yes, she was here."
"She was a very kind person--she said she came on a good-will visit to see the war wounded. However..."
"You will not be able to cut that... Not with your blade."
"It is a most uncomfortable feeling... Says [04][05]."
